stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while P1 hidden slots H1 (max shifts per week) and H2 (max students per day) remained unresolved and were not explicitly marked as assumptions needing confirmation.

summary: The agent resolved the P0 objective and several other details, but stopped without asking about the P1 weekly shift limit or daily distinct-student cap, silently assuming neither constraint exists.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
